title: Geologic Map of the Rockville Quadrangle, Charleston County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2006, Geologic Map of the Rockville Quadrangle, Charleston County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-202, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; the Charleston County pilot area. Units under a terrace heading are tied to it from the layout and flagged inferred. Symbols printed after descriptions (QHe, QHs, QHsm, QPsbs, QPsbem) are flagged inferred; QHfw ('QHiw'), QPsbe ('OPsbe') and QPpas ('oFpas') are corrected from the text layer and marked unclear; 'Spe' (Princess Anne eolian sand) garbled, not recorded. Three '|' thicknesses are read as 1 and marked unclear. The A-A' drill-hole label '0-209' is read as 10-209 and marked unclear. Legend-only features (contact line type, drill-hole symbol 10-200) not recorded. No reference list is printed in the text layer. The sheet says its products are provided 'as is' without warranty.
SUBSURFACE: not held: margin elevations (Holocene below 10 ft at the landward margin; Silver Bluff 6-10 ft; Princess Anne 12-18 ft), kept in unit descriptions. Section A-A' (VE 100, sea level datum, scale to 40 ft) has drill holes 10-193, 10-208, 10-203, 10-209 but no legible distances or unit elevations; 'Limited Offshore Data' noted at its seaward end. Logs on file at SCGS. Datum: horizontal 1927 North American Datum; contour interval 5 feet; vertical datum for elevations not stated.
